_about: Official EUROAVIA Ideathon 2026 Ansys bracket set-up, written 2026-11-05 from the organisers' card (Ideathon_Challenge_Ansys_2026.docx) and CAD (Eurovia Challenge 2026 CAD file.dsco, geometry measured in derived/features.json). Interpretation choices are marked [Y] in setup/boundary_conditions.md. Hole ids follow aerokit.bracket.features ordering (axis, then centre); check them against the first bracket_day.py hole scan before use. | v2 (5 Nov 13:10): non-design regions per industrial TO practice — base skin kept (one continuous mounting flange ties both lugs and all 4 bolts), lug eyes kept to the ORIGINAL edge distance (e = 61.4 mm above the pin), bolt bosses Ø105 through the plate; see setup/TO_v2_method.md
name: EUROAVIA 2026 cowling-support bracket (initial S275N design)

load_cases.name: LC1a Fz+97 kN, Fy+24 kN each pin
LC1b Fz+97 kN, Fy-24 kN each pin
LC1c Fz+97 kN, Fy +24/-24 kN (opposite, sensitivity)
LC2 My 2000 N m (1000 per pin bore)

non_design._about: support rings r 30 -> 52.5 mm (boss O105) over the full plate depth z 30-100; load rings r 30 -> 61.4 mm (= original top edge distance, ligament 31.4 mm) over each lug thickness; base skin = 2 voxel layers (15.6 mm at h 7.8 mm) of the original footprint

design_criteria._about: card: FoS 1.5 on yield at working temperature (>300 C) [Y: applied as vM_max*1.5 <= Fty(300 C)]; max displacement < 1/400 of largest dimension (661.01 mm -> 1.653 mm) | 5 Nov ~13:45 mentor: FoS 1.5 preferably on YIELD -> strength_basis 'yield' (U = 1.5 sigma / Fty(T))

_symmetry_about: 5 Nov: loads/supports are mirror-symmetric about x = 500 (pins, bolt pattern; LC2 sign unknown -> design must carry +-My) and about y = 200.28 (mid-plane of the pins; LC1a<->LC1b are mirror images, LC1c is self-mirror). Design variables tied over the 4-element mirror group (pattern grouping).
